channel_cn_description: Use a Qoder China account and authorize through the browser device flow. Models are discovered remotely.
channel_global_description: Use a Qoder Global account and authorize through the browser device flow. Models are discovered remotely.
model_ids_description: Optional, one model ID per line. When set, only these IDs are filtered from the remotely returned model IDs. This does not call models for inference.
invalid_model_ids: Model IDs must be nonempty single-line text, at most 200 characters each, with no control characters or duplicates.
invalid_options: Unsupported Qoder configuration fields were provided.
machine_os_description: Send OS and architecture in Qoder CLI format. The default is a Windows x64 client identity, not an automatically detected real machine.
machine_hostname_description: Optional. Normalized using official CLI rules before sending to Qoder. Leave blank for a stable stravia- name derived from the connection machine ID; the real hostname is not read.
invalid_machine_os: Client machine platform must be an OS and architecture combination from the list.
invalid_machine_hostname: Client hostname must be text without line breaks, at most 4096 bytes.
